hooks.name: usage-log-on-stop
hooks.description: Keep KIRO_USAGE.md current for the submission write-up.

action.prompt: If this turn used a notable Kiro feature (spec, hook, steering, MCP, property-based test, power) or finished a spec task, append one row to the Log table in KIRO_USAGE.md: time (ET), who, feature, what and why. Skip it for trivial turns.
